sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 186)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network and regional radio, three surreal comedy satires from Bob Elliott and Ray Goulding on *Bob and Ray* (Boston Common roving reporter, the Chicago Fire, and Alice the Ripper), Jimmy Durante and Garry Moore running a Catskills resort on *The Camel Comedy Caravan*, Harry Einstein on *Meet Me at Parky's* for Old Gold, and Les Damon & Claudia Morgan solving a fur vault murder on *The Adventures of the Thin Man* (1942–1952):
